text:
ash: short note  we should stop overloading `pin` as the canonical client id. propose an optional `claim` object in rollout responses so server side routing can rely on a single typed identity
bijal: sketch pls
ash: tiny example inline:
```"claim": {"type":"canonical","id":"sha256:...","name":"redwood/gptx-small","issuer":"catalog","cacheable":false}
```
carmen: keep lifecycle (ttl/revocation) in rollout metadata not claim. claim==identity only
bijal: ops concern: SDKs may start caching. default `cacheable:false` and allow `cache_ttl_seconds` only when true
infra-bot: note: Adding optional `claim` is a schema change. Recommend header gating: `X-Model-Claim-V1: true` so we can roll out behind opt-in
ash: agree header opt-in + shim that converts legacy `pin`->`claim` with type=alias and issuer=shim-service
carmen: telemetry: include hashed claim.id in traces; scrub before external export
bijal: tests: unit for shim conversions, integration for header gating, e2e for SDK cache behavior
ash: action items: ash spike shim, bijal draft SDK migration notes, carmen update telemetry scrub rules
infra-bot: scheduled 30m sync Fri 11am PT. RFC follow-up link to be attached
ash: filing RFC follow-up now. keeping claim optional by default. end thread
